    Evaluation at the projective labels: essential surjectivity #

    Lemma 2.9 (second part, graded-category.tex): "Given 0 → X → I⁰ → I¹ over Λ_e, lift its injectives to projectives Q⁰, Q¹ and their map to f : Q⁰ → Q¹. Its kernel is a second syzygy and hence projective, since gl.dim Λ ≤ 2. Exactness of M ↦ Me gives X ≅ (ker f)e." Proposition 2.10 (graded-category.tex): the injective A₀-modules D(A₀ e_x) are the evaluations of the injective labels I_x, by the socle and a dimension count.

    Here: the extension ext : A₀ → Λ by zero; the e-part of kernels; the dual representables J_p and injective copresentations; J_p ≅ ev(I_p) from the Hom-dimensions; essential surjectivity.
